test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the **INCORRECTLY** spelt word.
solution:
The incorrectly spelt word is 'Encouregement'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The correct spelling for the word is *encouragement *which means the action of giving someone support, confidence, or hope.
 
• The **meanings** of the other options are as** follows** - 
 
 
• Achievement - a thing is done successfully with effort, skill, or courage.
 
• Advertisement - a notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event or publicizing a job vacancy.
 
• Environment - the surroundings or conditions in which a person, animal, or plant lives or operates.
 
 
 
• Hence, option 1 is the correct answer.
